Meta.weights_interpretation: Higher weight values make an element more likely to be chosen when generating a story.

selection_rules.body_elements: Select 2-4 Events (weighted, no duplicates), 1-2 Conflicts (weighted), 0-3 Subplots (probabilistic).

Meta.randomization_seed_hint: Use weights and probabilities to bias random selection; normalize weights to probabilities before sampling.
